verdict.rationale: Grafana docs mention an official MCP server for connecting AI agents to Grafana and marketing copy claiming 'understand production systems faster using natural language,' suggesting some NL-to-query/chart capability exists via its AI/MCP integrations. However there is no concrete documentation, demo, or independent confirmation showing an end-to-end natural-language question producing an actual query or chart. Missing for 10: detailed docs/demo of the NL-to-query/chart workflow, hands-on or community validation that it works reliably, and clarity on which product tier/tool actually performs the translation.
